source_files.source_origin: triaged from CROSS_CUTTING_REVIEW: Content-addressed/scoped local artifact object store shared by transfer artifacts (E07), print exports (E06), rasters (E09), CAD/models (E10), and field packages (E13).

cross_engine_dependencies.relation: All tenant/project routes depend on E01 authentication, CSRF, RBAC/ACL, RLS, and project_access_guard.
Imports register/populate E02 spatial sources/layers with validated CRS transformations.
Raster uploads/GeoTIFFs are handled in E09 while vector GeoJSON/GPKG/Shapefile ZIP live in E07.

edge_cases: Malicious ZIP archives (zip bombs > 50 MiB expanded, > 64 entries, path traversal, uploads > 25 MiB) must be rejected.
Feature count (> 50,000), field count (> 100), and string length (> 4096) limits enforced consistently.
Unsupported CRS or unapproved CRS transformation edges and unsupported character encodings (outside utf-8/windows-1258/cp1252/latin-1) must fail with structured TransferError.
GeoPackage decimal notation, shapefile DBF encoding, and round-trip geometry/attribute fidelity.
Job cancellation, retry state transitions, and 24-hour artifact expiration (READY/EXPIRED/UNAVAILABLE).
